source='''def transform(grid):
    # Find monochrome rectangular outlines and fill their interiors.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if not cells:
            continue
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
            continue
        # A frame has all four sides in its color and a uniform interior.
        if not (all(grid[r0][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and
                all(grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and
                all(grid[r][c0] == color and grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0,r1+1))):
            continue
        interior = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1)]
        if not interior or len(set(interior)) != 1:
            continue
        # Odd-width apertures become 7; even-width apertures become 2.
        fill = 7 if (c1-c0-1) % 2 else 2
        for r in range(r0+1,r1):
            for c in range(c0+1,c1):
                out[r][c] = fill
    return out
'''

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for sr in range(h):
        for sc in range(w):
            color = grid[sr][sc]
            if color in (6, 8, 9) or (sr, sc) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(sr, sc)]
            seen.add((sr, sc))
            comp = []
            while stack:
                r, c = stack.pop()
                comp.append((r, c))
                for nr, nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and (nr,nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc] == color:
                        seen.add((nr,nc)); stack.append((nr,nc))
            r0,r1=min(r for r,c in comp),max(r for r,c in comp)
            c0,c1=min(c for r,c in comp),max(c for r,c in comp)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2: continue
            if not (all(grid[r0][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and

            fill = 7 if (c1-c0-1) % 2 else 2
            for r in range(r0+1,r1):
                for c in range(c0+1,c1): out[r][c] = fill
    return out
